frozen_before_inspecting: per-landmark (L0/L1/L5/L20 individually), per-family, per-length-bin breakdowns of Lane B recurrence. Only the AGGREGATE Lane B numbers already reported in reports/bcc-atlas-expansion-v1/ATLAS_DEEP/LANE_B_CAPTURE_MANIFEST.json (87 runs>=1 landmark, 62 runs>=2, 40 no-landmark, 17 ineligible) were known before this freeze -- the disaggregated numbers this gate computes were not yet inspected.

coverage_support_levels.definition_basis: support unit = distinct RUN (not raw tensor rows), consistent with every prior gate in this program (reports/multi-tensor-landmarks-v0/LANDMARK_VALIDATION_PLAN.md's rescue-prohibition, reports/reference-landmark-network-v0)
coverage_support_levels.WELL_OBSERVED: >=3 runs AND >=2 distinct prompt_ids AND >=2 distinct seeds
coverage_support_levels.MODERATE_SUPPORT: >=2 runs, but fails WELL_OBSERVED (e.g. only 1 prompt_id or only 1 seed)
coverage_support_levels.UNKNOWN: 0 runs -- no observation exists, not a claim of absence-in-the-model

landmark_replication_verdict_thresholds.note: Applied per-landmark (L0, L1, L5, L20) independently, against Lane B's 127 landmark-eligible runs (n_steps>=4).
landmark_replication_verdict_thresholds.REPLICATED_ON_LANE_B: recurs in >=3 distinct prompt_families AND >=2 distinct seeds AND recurrence_rate_among_eligible >= 0.15 (15%)
landmark_replication_verdict_thresholds.PARTIAL_REPLICATION: recurs in >=2 distinct prompt_families OR >=2 distinct seeds, AND recurrence_rate_among_eligible >= 0.05 (5%), but does not meet REPLICATED_ON_LANE_B
landmark_replication_verdict_thresholds.NOT_REPLICATED: fails PARTIAL_REPLICATION's bar (recurrence_rate_among_eligible < 0.05, or confined to a single family AND single seed)
landmark_replication_verdict_thresholds.rescue_prohibition: A landmark's canonical REFERENCE_LANDMARK_SUPPORTED status from reports/multi-tensor-landmarks-v0/ is NEVER changed by this gate's result -- this is an independent replication AUDIT on new data, not a re-validation that can revoke or upgrade the frozen prior status.

factual_math_verdict_thresholds.note: Applied specifically to the FACTUAL_GROUNDED and MATH_REASONING new non-zero observations (mission section 18), separately from the general landmark_replication_verdict_thresholds above -- these two families have much smaller eligible-run denominators (7 and 6 respectively) so the general thresholds' percentage bar is not statistically meaningful here; a count-based rule is used instead.
factual_math_verdict_thresholds.NONZERO_SUPPORT_ONLY: exactly 1 supporting run (any single prompt, any single seed) -- the current confirmed floor for both families per the Lane B manifest
factual_math_verdict_thresholds.LOW_SUPPORT_REPLICATION_CANDIDATE: >=2 supporting runs, but confined to a single prompt_id (only seed varies) OR a single landmark node
factual_math_verdict_thresholds.PARTIAL_REPLICATION: >=2 supporting runs spanning >=2 distinct prompt_ids AND >=2 distinct seeds (regardless of which landmark node)
factual_math_verdict_thresholds.NOT_ESTABLISHED: used whenever the evidence does not cleanly fit one of the above tiers, per mission's explicit allowance -- default when genuinely ambiguous, not a residual dump for a disappointing result

landmark_vs_nonlandmark_statistical_plan.predeclared_test: Mann-Whitney U (two-sided), non-parametric, no distributional assumption -- appropriate for small, possibly skewed per-window observable samples
landmark_vs_nonlandmark_statistical_plan.effect_size: rank-biserial correlation (from the Mann-Whitney U statistic), reported alongside raw and Bonferroni-adjusted p-values
landmark_vs_nonlandmark_statistical_plan.reporting_rule: raw p, adjusted-significance flag (p<0.004167), AND effect size reported together for every comparison -- significance alone is never used as the sole basis for any claim, per mission section 15
landmark_vs_nonlandmark_statistical_plan.populations_compared: A = observable value at t (the encounter step) for every landmark-encounter window (pooled across L0/L1/L5/L20, at that landmark's own layer). B = observable value at t for every eligible (n_steps>=4) non-landmark step at the SAME 4 layers (0,1,5,20), pooled -- i.e. same layers, same tensors, landmark-flagged step vs. not.
